Process bird count data

bdy_process_count_data.Rd

Uses bird counts and colony information to output several formatted tables used in the next steps of the analysis

Usage

bdy_process_count_data(
  sp,
  countData,
  colonies,
  first_year,
  last_year,
  max_foraging_range_km,
  h_km = 5,
  dist_regr_isol = 4 * h_km,
  regroupIsolates = T
)

Arguments

sp

character, latin name of the species of interest; this has to be a single species (not a vector)

countData

data frame of bird counts (at species level), where each line gives the number of individuals counted for a given colony, species, and year. Must have at least the following columns:

  • 'species_latin': character, latin name of the species

  • 'year': numeric, year during which the observation was made

  • 'colony': character, name of the colony where the observation was made, which should be found also in th column 'colony' of argument 'colonies'

  • 'count': numeric, the count value for this given year, colony, species

colonies

sf table where each row is a colony of interest, as outputted by bdy_summarise_colonies() Must contain the columns:

  • 'colony': character, name of the colony

  • 'colony_code': character, unique identifiers for each colony

  • 'lat': numeric, latitude of the colony

  • 'lon': numeric, longitude of the colony

first_year

numeric, minimum year of bird counts to integrate in trends estimates

last_year

numeric, maximum year of bird counts to integrate in trends estimates

max_foraging_range_km

numeric, maximum foraging range in kilometers for the species of interest

h_km

bandwidth (in km) used by the Clustering Algorithm (colonies within that distance of another will be regrouped)

dist_regr_isol

maximum distance to regroup an isolated colony to closest cluster

regroupIsolates

logical; whether isolated colonies should be grouped with closest cluster (based on dist_regr_isol)

Value

List of 5 objects:

  • species: character, latin name of the species of interest

  • group_counts_sp: table of counts summarised by year and group of colonies

  • ppa_yr_sp: table of proportion of colonies that are surveyed within a given group of colonies (rows) and a given year (columns)

  • colonies_sp: table of colonies where the species of interest breeds

  • sea_area_sp: numeric vector, proportion of sea area around each colony
